top_reply.text:
Surely they can build a tool that just splits the output into 3 to 10 different blocks and calls the same number of different models, even the mainstream ones, to each paraphrase the block they've been assigned. Then if the reader doesn't know where the text was split they won't notice the presence of any of the watermarks.

Of course if it's code you have to take your stitched output and give it to another agent that checks if it works and if not then i guess you just go back to the raw output and add a useless random comment.
